children: Danone's U.S. essential dairy and plant-based product business continues to see weak trends, despite recent improvements in non-milk dairy, Tom Sykes at Deutsche Bank says in a note. There are still headwinds that the company needs to overcome to be able to improve its performance in the U.S., Sykes says in the note. More broadly, the consumer staples segment will continue to underperform the market, as long as consumer wallets underperform nominal GDP, he adds. Shares are down 0.46% at 60.26 euros. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
